tag.name: Fluent Forms - form_submit and Clarity form_ref (listener)

parameter.value:
<script>
/* Fluent Forms (owner, 21 Oct 2026): on a sent form, GA4 form_submit with the form and its reference, and Clarity's
   form_ref tag. Only with analytics consent (this tag needs analytics_storage). No email, name or phone. */
(function () {
  if (!window.jQuery) return;
  jQuery(document.body).on('fluentform_submission_success', function (e, d) {
    try {
      var form = d && d.form ? jQuery(d.form) : jQuery(e.target);
      var name = form.closest('[data-kit-form]').attr('data-kit-form') || 'form-' + (form.attr('data-form_id') || '');
      var r = (d && d.response) || {}, msg = (r.data && r.data.result && r.data.result.message) || (r.result && r.result.message) || '';
      var m = /data-aw-ref="([A-Z0-9-]+)"/.exec(msg), ref = m ? m[1] : '';
      window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
      window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'form_submit', form: name, form_ref: ref });
      if (ref && typeof window.clarity === 'function') window.clarity('set', 'form_ref', ref);
    } catch (x) { /* never break the form */ }
  });
})();
</script>
